pages.title: Finding Deep Iron
pages.text: Default deposits: Overworld, Y 10 to 30. Veins target up to 5 blocks, with 10 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 1. Some deposits also have biome restrictions.

pages.title: Working Deep Iron
pages.text: Smelt Deep Iron Ore or Deep Iron Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 230 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 2.$(br)Mining efficiency: 6.2.$(br)Material damage bonus: 1.7.$(br)Enchantability: 19.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 2, chestplate 4, leggings 3, boots 1.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 1.0.$(br)Enchantability: 20.

pages.title: Armor: Aquatic
pages.text: Grants Water Breathing and improved Mobility in water depending on how many armor pieces are worn (it also grants night vision with 2 or more armor pieces).

pages.title: Tool: Diver
pages.text: Improved tool harvest speed when underwater (3 times the normal underwater speed)

pages.title: Weapon: Diver
pages.text: Enhanced weapon damage when underwater (+3 hearts of damage)
